Add support for grouping nodes in distribute function

The `distribute()` function now supports grouping MPI nodes to isolate communication within subgroups. This allows nested parallelization where tasks can safely call `distribute()` internally without interfering with other top-level tasks. Groups can be defined either by size (equal groups) or as a list of group sizes (unequal groups). Results cannot be collected across groups, and proper cleanup ensures the original communicator is restored after execution.
